app.title: MnemoHermes
app.tagline: Hermes roams the world. You govern what it remembers.

tasks.heading: Tasks
tasks.intro: Give the agent a task. It runs on your machine with its tools; when it reaches a guarded action it stops and asks you here. The command you approve is exactly the one shown.
tasks.placeholder: e.g. sort my Downloads folder by type
tasks.lastSign: last sign of life {{s}} s ago
tasks.approvalTitle: The agent wants to run this:
tasks.smartDenied: The smart guardian already said no — you can still allow it once.
tasks.countdown: Hermes decides alone in {{s}} s if you do not answer.
tasks.expired: The deadline passed: Hermes decided alone. See what it did below.

agents.intro: Each profile is a complete agent — its own memory, skills, gateway and Telegram bot. One token per bot, Telegram's law.
agents.botfatherHint: Create a dedicated bot via @BotFather on Telegram (one token per agent), then paste the token here.
agents.mainGatewayNote: Its gateway is driven from the Status tab.
agents.onlyMain: One agent so far: the main one. A second profile is a separate Hermes, with its own memory, skills and Telegram bot, that never touches the main one.
agents.mainTelegramNote: Telegram is linked in the Channels tab.

channels.allowedHint: Your id, and those of the people allowed to talk to the assistant.
channels.saved: Saved (backup created). The gateway reads it on its next start.
channels.invalidToken: That does not look like a BotFather token.
channels.invalidIds: IDs must be numbers separated by commas.
channels.othersHint: Not from the app yet. They go through the Hermes setup command in a terminal.
channels.intro: A channel is a messaging app you talk to your assistant from, your phone for instance. Without one, it only answers in the Chat tab.
channels.openToAll: No allow-list: whoever finds this bot can talk to it and spends your credits.
channels.step1: On Telegram, open @BotFather, create a bot, copy its token.
channels.step2: Open @userinfobot to learn your numeric id.
channels.step3: Paste both below, save, then restart the gateway.
channels.tokenKept: A token is already saved. Leave empty to keep it.
channels.voiceHint: Send a voice note: it is transcribed on this machine and handled like a written message. To get the reply as a voice note, type /voice on in the Telegram chat; /voice all speaks every reply, /voice off stops. The voice follows the app language.
channels.voicePrivacy: The voice notes you send stay here. The text of each spoken reply, however, goes through Microsoft's speech service.
channels.voiceRouteApp: The voice chosen in the app, Settings › Voice, spoken here
channels.voiceRouteOther: You set the voice yourself in config.yaml; the app leaves it alone.
channels.voiceRouteSaved: Saved. The gateway reads it at its next start.
channels.voiceRouteReason_NO_VOICE_PREFS: No voice chosen in the app yet: open Settings › Voice.
channels.voiceRouteReason_UNSUPPORTED_FAMILY: The system voice and ElevenLabs cannot leave the window: pick a local voice in Settings › Voice.
channels.voiceRouteReason_LICENSE_REQUIRED: Local voices are a licensed feature.
channels.voiceRouteReason_ENGINE_NOT_INSTALLED: The chosen engine is not installed: Settings › Voice.
channels.voiceRouteReason_VOICE_NOT_INSTALLED: The chosen Piper voice is not on disk: Settings › Voice.
channels.voiceRouteReason_NO_CLONE_SAMPLE: The companion speaks with your voice, but no sample is recorded: Settings › Voice.

tools.intro: What your assistant may do, depending on where it is spoken to from. Tick, save, restart the gateway.
tools.empty: No tools block in the config, and no channel linked.
tools.saved: Saved (backup created). The gateway reads it on its next start.
tools.terminalWarning: terminal open from a messaging app
tools.presetNote: Unticking a box replaces the preset with the ticked list.
tools.presetUnknown: Preset “{{name}}”: the app cannot read what it contains, nothing is ticked for it.
tools.noBlock: No setting: Hermes gives it every tool, terminal included.
tools.channelsUnread: The linked channels could not be read: a channel without a setting may be missing here.

error.TOOLSETS_BLOCK_UNREADABLE: The tools block in the config has a line the app cannot read. Nothing was written: fix it in config.yaml, or remove the block.

status.heading: Agent status
status.notWired: The Hermes connector is not wired on this host yet. Update Mnemosyne OS, then retry.
status.updateDone: Hermes is up to date ✓ — restart the gateway.
status.updateFailed: Update failed — see the output below.
status.updateHint: Repairs the embedded runtime (e.g. the SQLite the gateway warns about). No terminal needed.
status.installHint: Mnemosyne OS downloads a verified Hermes Agent release ({{version}}, about {{mb}} MB) and builds it on its own Python. No terminal, no account, nothing else touched on this machine.
status.installFailed: Install failed — see the output below.
status.installCancelled: Install stopped. Nothing was kept as installed.
status.installBusy: Stop the gateway first — the install replaces the files it runs from.
status.actionsMissing: images not wired — restart the gateway
status.voiceMissing: voice notes not transcribed — restart the gateway

settings.heading: Settings

port.label: Hermes API server port
port.hint: Empty = auto-detect. Used by the Chat tab.

settings.saveError: Could not save (outside the Mnemosyne host?)

brain.heading: Agent brain
brain.intro: Hermes thinks with Mnemosyne's inference engine — local model, cloud credits or your own keys. Never memory here: a brain only.
brain.enable: Serve the brain to Hermes (local port)
brain.tokensToday: {{n}} / {{cap}} tokens today (as the providers reported them)
brain.tokensUnmetered: {{n}} call(s) without a token count — not counted, not free
brain.spentTodayFloor: Spent today: ≥ ${{usd}} ({{priced}}/{{total}} calls priced — the rest unknown, not free)
brain.toolsNative: Native tools: yes — the agent can execute its tool calls through this brain.
brain.toolsNone: Native tools: no — this brain serves chat only; tool execution needs a Gemini or Vertex route in Mnemosyne's AI settings.
brain.pasteHint: Or paste by hand into Hermes' config:
brain.applied: Applied ✓ (backup created) — restart Hermes to reload.
brain.auxApply: Also route auxiliary services to Mnemosyne
brain.auxHint: Vision, web summaries, compression, titles, session search: Hermes' side quests think with your OS too. (Voice comes in a next milestone.)

chat.thinking: Hermes is thinking (it may use its tools — this can take a while)…
chat.empty: Talk to your Hermes agent — the gateway must be running (hermes gateway).
chat.errNotRunning: The Hermes gateway is not answering. Run “hermes gateway” in a terminal, then try again.

chat.errTimeout: Hermes did not answer in time. It may still be working — try again.
chat.commandsHint: Partial support here — full on Telegram and in the CLI. Click to insert the command.

cmd.help: The command reference, in the chat

cmd.title: Name the current session

chat.errInterrupted: The reply was interrupted before it finished.
chat.micNoGateway: The Hermes gateway is not answering: start it from the Status tab.
chat.micNoEngine: No transcription engine: pick one in Settings › Voice (local Whisper or a cloud key).
chat.listeningPlaceholder: Speak, then press “Send the voice note”
chat.spokenTruncated: (the beginning only, the rest is to read)

voiceErr.MIC_BUSY: The microphone is already held by another window.
voiceErr.TTS_FAILED: The voice could not speak: check Settings › Voice.

skills.intro: A skill is a know-how sheet Hermes reads when a task fits: how to read a PDF, triage an inbox, talk to Obsidian. They ship with Hermes.
skills.ourInstalled: The mnemosyne-memory skill is installed: your assistant knows the rules of your memory.
skills.ourMissing: The mnemosyne-memory skill is not installed.
skills.ourWhy: It teaches the assistant how to use your memory: which vault to ask, when to ask rather than search, never to mix. Installed from our public repo, with Hermes' quarantine and scan.
skills.installed: Installed. The gateway reads it on its next start.

installError.ALREADY_INSTALLED: It is already on the shelf.
installError.CLI_NOT_FOUND: The Hermes executable cannot be found. Reinstall the assistant from the Status tab.
installError.NOT_ON_SHELF: The installer finished without putting anything on the shelf. Hermes' scan may have refused it, see the lines below.
installError.INSTALL_FAILED: The install failed. The lines below say where.
installError.INVALID_IDENTIFIER: That identifier is neither owner/repo/path nor an https URL to a SKILL.md.
installError.INVALID_NAME: That is not a skill name.
installError.BUNDLED: This skill ships with Hermes: it can be disabled, not uninstalled.
installError.REMOVE_FAILED: The removal failed. The lines below say where.
installError.STILL_ON_SHELF: The tool finished but the skill is still on the shelf.
installError.ALREADY_EXISTS: A skill with that name is already on the shelf.
installError.OPEN_FAILED: The folder could not be opened.
installError.SKILLS_DISABLED_UNREADABLE: The disabled-skills list in the config is not readable by the app. Nothing was written.
installError.INVALID_SKILL_NAME: One name in the list is not a skill name.

skills.installingWhat: Hermes' installer fetches the sheet from GitHub, quarantines it, scans it, then puts it on the shelf. Its lines appear below as they come.
skills.shelfHint: Ticked, Hermes may read it. Unticked, it no longer sees it. A change is read at the gateway's next start.
skills.disabledUnreadable: The disabled-skills list in the config is not readable by the app: the switches are frozen and say nothing certain.
skills.disabledSaved: Saved (backup created). The gateway reads it on its next start.
skills.uninstallingWhat: Hermes takes the skill off the shelf and out of its registry.
skills.mineWhat: A skill of your own is a folder with a SKILL.md inside, the same format as Claude Code skills. Imported, it is copied onto the shelf under "custom"; the original folder stays where it is.
skills.mineStep1: Create a folder named after the skill.
skills.mineStep2: Put a SKILL.md in it: a name / description header between two --- lines, then the instructions.
skills.mineStep3: Import the folder here, then restart the gateway.
skills.imported: {{name}} is on the shelf. Restart the gateway so Hermes reads it.
skills.advancedWarning: A skill is a script written by someone else, run on your machine. Install only what you know the author of. Hermes' scan blocks the known-dangerous, not the rest.
skills.advancedHint: An owner/repo/path identifier on GitHub, or the https URL of a SKILL.md. Hermes quarantines, scans, then puts it on the shelf.

inbox.intro: When Hermes remembers something into your memory, it comes through here first. Keep accepts it, Move files it in another vault, Reject erases it.
inbox.empty: Nothing to review. Hermes has not remembered anything yet.
inbox.multiPart: Multi-part document — manage it from the vault itself.
inbox.emptyHint: Tell it "remember that…" from Telegram or the Chat tab, and its note will show up here.
inbox.bodyTruncated: Note cut at 4,000 characters here; the vault has the rest.

welcome.heading: Welcome to MnemoHermes
welcome.body: Four steps, all optional, and your agent thinks with your OS, talks to you on your channels, and stays under your governance.
welcome.notInstalled: No Hermes install found on this machine.

posture.heading: 2. Where does your agent live?
posture.body: An autonomous agent executes what it reads. Pick a posture in one click — it writes both sides of the bridge: Hermes' tools and the brain cap. You can always change it.
posture.applied: Applied ✓ (backup created) — brain cap now {{cap}}/day. Restart the Hermes gateway.
posture.footnote: Every preset backs up Hermes' config before writing. On a machine that holds your passwords or wallets, prefer Fortress — or run the agent on a dedicated machine / VPS.

fortress.title: Fortress — important machine
fortress.body: Minimal tools everywhere (no terminal, no skill self-install), manual approval, blocking tirith scan, low brain cap. The most closed attack surface.

balanced.title: Balanced — recommended
balanced.body: Cautious messaging (recall, no shell), full CLI, smart approval, normal brain cap. The wizard's default.

yolo.title: YOLO — throwaway PC, "may burn"
yolo.body: Everything open on every channel, approvals off, high brain cap. Only on a remote machine with nothing to lose.

profile.heading: 3. Who are you to it?
profile.body: The profile your agent reads every session. Mnemosyne can draft it from your memory — review, adjust, apply. Or fill the questionnaire, or paste an existing profile if you are migrating.
profile.placeholder: Who you are, what you do, how you want it to talk to you…

finish.started: Gateway up ✓ — your agent is online.

common.restartFailed: The gateway did not come back. See the Status tab.

search.heading: Agent web search
search.intro: Your agent searches with your OS's own engine — Mnemosyne's local SearXNG, no API key, no third party reading its queries.
search.dockerInstall: The engine lives in a Docker container — install Docker Desktop first.
search.dockerStart: Launch Docker Desktop, then click again — the engine lives in a container.
search.notSetUp: Enable the SearXNG engine in Mnemosyne's web settings first.
search.starting: The engine is starting — click again in a few seconds.
search.notAnswering: The container runs but does not answer — check Mnemosyne's web settings.
search.searchOnly: SearXNG covers SEARCH only — page extraction needs a separate provider (later milestone).
